headline: Correspondence between Tomás Chavez M. and Brian Bell reveals insights into their music journey
content: The success of Africa concluded in the Teal Album.Subsequently comes the Black Album. Both albums consist of cover tracks.Why does he believe the former was more successful than its successor? There always goes to happen that people remember... Always together.Sometimes we’re in the studio Patrick Wilson, Scott Shriner and myself writing lyrics.Later we come to agreement.The guitarist reflects on his pivotal role in nineties rock.Not very interesting topic but it has been different.We tried various instruments maybe our blues album better than another.There isn’t anything to say we did everything playing guitars going out saying we told you so, but it was great for us.It felt like climbing up a mountain towards something distinct.That irony being that ourselves were born listening to heavy metal later joining the band led to our own style formation.

headline: DISIDENTES SOFTEN DISCORD WITHIN THE OFFICIALIST GROUP OF PERUVIAN FOR CHANGE PARTY
content: The discrepancies within the parliamentary group of Peruvians for Change have led to its fragmentation. The congresswomen Mercedes Araoz, Carlos Bruce, and Ana María Choquehuanca announced their departure yesterday morning from the officialist bloc which began back in 2016. Their resignation comes after meetings between the head of state and Vice-President Arauz regarding the proposal to advance elections and discussions about the president Martin Vizcarra over leaked conversations revealing his dealings with authorities aimed at reversing certain licenses.

headline: VICE-PRESIDENT MARTÍNEZ CALLS TO ADVANCE REFORM LAW THROUGH IMMEDIATE ACTION AS REQUESTED BY EXECUTIVE POWER
content: During celebrations marking the city foundation anniversary held in Huánuco, President Martin Vizcarra urged Congress to discuss the constitutional amendment law proposed weeks ago aiming to bring forward general election date to next year starting immediately following commission installations scheduled Tuesday August 20 under leadership of Rosa Bartra.
